    Long lines #

    In a minimal representation-infinite distributive algebra with representation-finite cover pieces and unbounded graded indecomposables, the universal cover has lines of every length (linesOfEveryLength). This removes the last input of Theorem A.

    theorem LargeIndecomposable.RayCat.exists_cline {P : Type} [CategoryTheory.Category.{0, 0} P] [CategoryTheory.Limits.HasZeroMorphisms P] [IsRayCategory P] [Fintype P] [DecidableEq P] {x₀ : P} {S : Finset (Cover x₀)} {k : Type u} [Field k] [IsAlgClosed k] (hS : Cover.Convex ↑S) (hne : S.Nonempty) (hacycCov : CoverAcyclic x₀) (hint : ∀ (a b : Cover x₀), (interval a b).Finite) (hlsc : CoverLocalSC x₀) (hnc : RayQuiver.NoContour P) (hrep : PieceRepFin k S) (N : AR.FDMod k (PieceAlg k S)) (hN : AR.IndNT N) (hsinc : ∀ (i : (pieceQuiver S).V), ∃ (y : N.carrier), pev i • y ≠ 0) {M : ℕ} (hM : ∀ (x y : P) (l : List (RayQuiver.quiver P).A) (h : FinQuiver.PathFrom x l y), RayQuiver.pathMor l x y h ≠ 0 → l.length < M) {m : ℕ} (hlarge : (2 * morCard P + 1) ^ (2 * m + 2 * M + 1) < S.card) :
    ∃ (L : CLine x₀), m ≤ L.n

    theorem LargeIndecomposable.RayCat.exists_connected_piece {P : Type} [CategoryTheory.Category.{0, 0} P] [CategoryTheory.Limits.HasZeroMorphisms P] [IsRayCategory P] [Fintype P] [DecidableEq P] {x₀ : P} {S : Finset (Cover x₀)} {k : Type u} [Field k] (hpar : ParEq S) (hacyc : ∀ (i : (pieceQuiver S).V) (l : List (pieceQuiver S).A), l ≠ [] → ¬FinQuiver.PathFrom i l i) (hS : Cover.Convex ↑S) (X : Rep k (pieceQuiver S)) (hind : X.IsIndec) :
    ∃ (S₀ : Finset (Cover x₀)) (_ : S₀ ⊆ S), Cover.Convex ↑S₀ ∧ S₀.Nonempty ∧ (∀ (T : Set (pieceQuiver S₀).V), T.Nonempty → (∀ (α : (pieceQuiver S₀).A), (pieceQuiver S₀).src α ∈ T ↔ (pieceQuiver S₀).tgt α ∈ T) → T = Set.univ) ∧ SuppIn S₀ X
